definition: TCID50 is a measure of infectivity defined by the dose estimated to produce detectable infection in half of the tissue culture test units.
entry_text: TCID50 is a measure of infectivity defined by the dose estimated to produce detectable infection in half of the tissue culture test units.
example: A reader distinguishes a published TCID50 result from a count of physical particles.
label: 50% tissue culture infectious dose (TCID50)
